description.value: Trails End is a cafe, taproom, and bistro operated by Smugglers Trail Caskworks, situated beside the Fraser River in the historic village of Fort Langley. The spot pours the brewery's cask-conditioned craft ales alongside a full food menu running from breakfast through dinner, making it a natural refuelling stop on the Transcanada Trail corridor. Live music on Saturday evenings and outdoor seating add to the appeal for cyclists finishing a ride through the Fort Langley area.
